admin.belowThresholdHint:
📌 Once the threshold is reached, enable strict CSP protection.
How: add the `CSP_STRICT=true` env var in your deployment platform (Vercel) and redeploy.
admin.alertDesc: Registered users reached {count}. We recommend enabling strict CSP to harden against XSS (small cost: slightly slower first paint). To enable: set the env var below to "true" in your deployment platform (Vercel) and redeploy. No code change needed.
